'''His Majesty's Government Communications Centre''' ('''HMGCC''') is an organisation which provides electronics and software to support the communication needs of the [[Government of the United Kingdom]]. Based at [[Hanslope Park]], near [[Milton Keynes]] in [[Buckinghamshire]], it is closely linked with the [[Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office]] and the [[British intelligence agencies]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-12-06 |title=Inside the secret complex making high-tech gadgets for UK spies |language=en-GB |work=BBC News |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-67626880 |access-date=2023-12-06}}</ref>

==History==
HMGCC was founded in 1938, specialising in overseas bespoke wireless communications.<ref name="aboutus">{{Cite web|url=https://www.hmgcc.gov.uk/about-us/ |title=Who we are |website=[[HMGCC]]|accessdate=13 January 2024}}</ref> HMGCC used to have a communications centre at [[Signal Hill (England)|Signal Hill]] near [[Gawcott]], in Buckinghamshire. Stephen Ball was Chief Executive until 2000,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www1.plymouth.ac.uk/graduation/honorarydegrees/honoraries2013/Pages/Stephen-Ball.aspx |title=Honorary Doctorate 2013 - Stephen Ball|publisher=Plymouth University |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140124060623/http://www1.plymouth.ac.uk/graduation/honorarydegrees/honoraries2013/Pages/Stephen-Ball.aspx |archive-date=24 January 2014 }}</ref> when Dr John Widdowson took over; Widdowson moved to [[Government Communications Headquarters|GCHQ]] in 2005.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/pais/people/aldrich/vigilant/lectures/gchq/widdowson/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140101142735/http://text.www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/pais/people/aldrich/vigilant/lectures/gchq/widdowson/|archive-date=1 January 2014|title=John Widdowson becomes Director of CESG|publisher=University of Warwick|date=28 November 2013|access-date=31 December 2013|url-status=live}}</ref> Sarah-Jill Lennard was CEO from 2008 to 2011.<ref>{{cite web| url = https://www.cifas.org.uk/about-cifas/governance/sarah-jill-lennard| title = Sarah-Jill Lennard, Non-Executive Director| website = CIFAS: Fighting Economic Crime Together| access-date = 5 July 2023 }}</ref> Juliette Wilcox was CEO from 2019 to 2021.

==Structure==
The organisation provides bespoke solutions to fit the needs of the government, its organisations, and specifically its intelligence assets. As of 2024, HMGCC had teams in the following areas:<ref name="ourareas">{{Cite web|url=https://www.hmgcc.gov.uk/our-teams/ |title=Areas |website=[[HMGCC]]|accessdate=13 January 2024}}</ref>
* [[Software engineering]]
* [[Manufacturing]]
* [[Corporate services|Corporate and support]]
* [[Project management|Project and programme management]]
* [[Systems engineering]]
* [[Electronic hardware|Hardware]] engineering
